title: Sand physics on DMR - Death Rally (1996) Inspired postapocalyptic driving game
author: VegetableTour1920
selftext:
Hello,  
yesterday I posted some a bit gameplay on the game campaign. I got a comment on how good the sand looked, so I wanted to put it a bit to the limit and used in-game challenge editor to create a Sand Buggy race on a sand track giving everyone harpoons to make it a bit more interesting. Dynamic weather is also on, so there was a bit sand blowing at one point.  
    
The ruts have real geometry (if that setting is on - it has some cost), it affects driving. Ruts follow car weight, how deep the tyre is pushed to ground, how wide the tire is...  
    
I made a lot of improvements while testing - the worker that creates the sand ruts prioritizes now the ruts that are being made front of your car, not from car behind. It also keeps the whole track ruts in memory if it can (before it forgot if you went too far and had to draw again).  
    
There is one section of the track where it struggles to draw everything (the "chicane" on west side). I'm not exactly clear why is it. Also in the bumpy section a couple times the nose of the buggy hit the top of the bump and unrealistically it was a hard knock (I already improved that somewhat after the video).

There is a bit more about the game here if you're interested [https://playdmr.com/](https://playdmr.com/)

replies.body: Thank you for the comment, understandable. I added an edit.

replies.body: I'd really like that, if it can have proper systems, not be abandoned mid-way.
